name: MITS Altair 8800
summary: MITS offered the Intel 8080-based Altair 8800 as a kit or assembled computer.
description: A commercially offered 8080-based expandable microcomputer sold in kit and assembled forms to hobbyists and other users.

date.basis: The ACS newsletter issue bears November 1974.

events.statement: The November 1974 ACS Newsletter described a MITS Altair 8800 kit and an upcoming Popular Electronics article.
events.scope: Prospective computer kit as described in the newsletter
events.caveats: The advance notice does not establish completed computers, availability for sale, or shipment in November 1974. The newsletter’s early specifications and prices require comparison with the production configuration.

evidence.locator: November 1974 issue, COMPUTER KITS, Altair 8800 Computer Kit
evidence.supports: Names the kit, manufacturer and Intel 8080 and anticipates the 1975 magazine article.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source for this event, not necessarily first preceding work.

events.statement: The Altair 8800 appeared in Popular Electronics in January 1975; a 1975 MITS advertisement offered kit and assembled versions.

evidence.supports: CHM dates introduction to 1975 and describes the kit.

evidence.locator: PDF p. 3, price list and coupon; p. 4, 8080 description
evidence.supports: MITS offers the kit and assembled computer, describes the Intel 8080, and the time-payment offer expires July 30, 1975.

events.caveats: The manufacturer offer and magazine introduction do not establish the date of first shipment, a sale, or commercial availability for all of 1975.

contributions.resource: Offered kit and assembled Altair 8800 computers.

evidence.locator: PDF p. 3, price list and coupon
evidence.supports: MITS offered the kit and assembled computer for sale.

earliest_record.rationale: The November 1974 contemporary description predates the 1975 magazine feature and offer; it does not prove the machine was completed or shipped.

measures.conditions: MITS 1975 advertisement, computer kit alone; memory and postage separately priced; prices subject to change
measures.subject: MITS Altair 8800 base computer
measures.money_context: Nominal manufacturer offer, 1975; shipping, memory and other extras excluded.

measures.conditions: MITS 1975 advertisement, assembled and tested computer alone; extras separately priced; prices subject to change
measures.subject: MITS Altair 8800 base computer
measures.money_context: Nominal manufacturer offer, 1975; shipping, memory and other extras excluded.

caveats: A base price is not the cost of a fully configured system; prices may have changed during 1975.

research.note: Independent reader checked a November 1974 advance description, 1975 museum account and subsequent MITS advertising; production and shipment dates remain open. Later event and measure enrichment has not yet received independent review.

places.note: The 1975 MITS offer lists an Albuquerque, New Mexico address; country-level place does not assert location of first production.
